summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of category-grouped product display feature on HomePage and StorefrontPage. All 12 features tested successfully. Products are correctly grouped by category sections, sorted by category position (Electronics=1, Fashion=2, Home & Garden=3, Kitchen=4), and products within each category are sorted by product position. Category filter dropdown works correctly - selecting specific category shows flat grid, selecting 'All Categories' returns to grouped view. Price filter also correctly switches to flat grid when active.
passed_tests: Homepage (/) shows products grouped by category sections when no filter is active
Homepage category sections are sorted by category position: Electronics (pos 1), Fashion (pos 2), Home & Garden (pos 3), Kitchen (pos 4)
Homepage products within Electronics section sorted by position: Sony Wireless Headphones (1), Black Studio Headphones (2), Minimalist Smartphone (3), Smart Watch Pro (4), AirPods Pro Max (5)
Homepage category filter dropdown works - selecting 'Electronics' shows flat grid with 5 products
Homepage selecting 'All Categories' returns to grouped view
Homepage price filter 'Dưới 500K' shows flat grid with 3 products (Minimalist Succulent Pot, Ceramic Coffee Set, Handwoven Rattan Baskets)
Homepage resetting price filter to 'Tất cả giá' returns to grouped view
Storefront (/shop/the-elite-shop) shows products grouped by category sections when no filter is active
Storefront category sections sorted by position: Electronics (1), Fashion (2), Home & Garden (3), Kitchen (4)
Storefront products within categories sorted by product position
Storefront category filter dropdown works - selecting specific category shows flat grid
Storefront cart + checkout flow: add item, open cart drawer, click checkout, fill form, place order, redirect to thank-you page
Thank you page shows order confirmation with order ID, items list, and total
Shop Owner dashboard category position reordering (up/down buttons) works correctly
Category position changes are saved with toast notification 'Đã lưu vị trí'
known_limitations: New orders from storefront do NOT persist across page navigations in dashboard - this is expected behavior for mock-only frontend where JavaScript context resets on full page navigation
Mock data changes (orders, category positions) are stored in memory and reset when page reloads
critical_code_review_comments: The grouped view logic (isGroupedView flag) correctly checks: selectedCategory === 'All Categories' && !searchQuery && priceFilter.id === 'all'
Categories are properly sorted by position in both mockData.js handlers and component rendering
Products within categories are sorted by position using .sort((a, b) => (a.position || 0) - (b.position || 0))
